{"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","response":{"candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode usually utilizes Reluctant Doubling.\n  // We preserve this behavior to maintain solver stability properties,\n  // as the requested algorithm (LBD-based) targets Focused mode dynamics.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve Exponential Moving Averages (EMA) of LBD\n  const double fast = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Compute the stabilized trend ratio R\n  // R = (Fast_EMA + K) / (Slow_EMA + K)\n  const double K = 1.0;\n  const double R = (fast + K) / (slow + K);\n\n  // Step 3: Determine dynamic multiplier M\n  double M = 1.0;\n  if (R \u003c 0.85) {\n      M = 1.4; // Search quality improving, extend run\n  } else if (R \u003e 1.15) {\n      M = 0.7; // Search quality degrading, curtail run\n  }\n\n  // Step 4: Retrieve the solver's scheduled restart conflict limit\n  const uint64_t limit = solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts;\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"restart strategy: fast=%g slow=%g R=%g M=%g \"\n                            \"limit=%\" PRIu64 \" threshold=%g conflicts=%\" PRIu64,\n                            fast, slow, R, M, limit, (double)limit * M, CONFLICTS);\n\n  // Step 5: Trigger a restart if current conflict count exceeds the limit * M\n  return CONFLICTS \u003e (limit * M);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}],"role":"model"},"index":0}],"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"ctWKaZ-LK4Saz7IPk8atwAY","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5854,"modality":"TEXT"}],"thoughtsTokenCount":7489,"totalTokenCount":13797,"promptTokenCount":5854,"candidatesTokenCount":454}},"key":"req-0001"}
